{"tools":{"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset.Write":{"description":"Transactionally applies a DSL document and returns its canonical form and a new revision. A
failure leaves the asset unchanged.

Use Write for a complete document or a large structural change. Use Edit for a targeted
change that can be expressed as exact replacements against text you just read.

Top-level entries use upsert semantics: omitted entries remain and produce a warning. Delete an
entry with a tombstone such as (event `Foo` :!delete). Deleting a missing entry only warns.

Dsl is omitted when bDslOmitted is true because the submitted document is already canonical.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset.Write","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"assetPath":{"type":"string","description":"Content-browser path to the Blueprint."},"dsl":{"type":"string","description":"Complete DSL document to apply to the selected scope."},"scope":{"type":"string","description":"Sub-document selector; empty selects the whole asset.","default":""}},"required":["assetPath","dsl"],"additionalProperties":false},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"title":"GraphDslWriteResult","type":"object","properties":{"dsl":{"type":"string","description":"The canonical DSL after the operation. Empty when bDslOmitted is true: the result is exactly the text you could predict, so it is not repeated.","default":""},"bDslOmitted":{"type":"boolean","description":"True when Dsl is omitted: the canonical result is byte-identical to the text you could already predict, so your copy is correct as-is.","default":false},"revision":{"type":"string","description":"New revision token. Use this to anchor subsequent Edit calls.","default":""},"warnings":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Non-fatal issues; empty on a clean apply. Warnings do not mean the text changed: when bDslOmitted is true your copy still matches; when Dsl is present, it is the authoritative text.","default":[]}}}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute","readOnlyHint":false}}},"errors":{}}
